entities.name: Jordi Tarrés
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jordi Tarrés is a Spanish former international motorcycle trials rider. He competed in the FIM Trial World Championships from 1985 to 1997. Tarrés is notable for being a seven-time motorcycle trials world champion. He is the third most successful trials rider in history, after Dougie Lampkin with 12 titles and Toni Bou with 34. In 2010, Tarrés was named an FIM Legend for his motorcycling achievements.
